name: post_broadcast
description: Collects image-required posts from configured websites, rewrites captions through the agent workflow, and broadcasts approved posts to active Telegram subscribers with explicit subscribe/unsubscribe state.
when_to_use: User wants to automatically collect image posts from websites such as Pinterest boards, manage Telegram broadcast subscribers including opt-out, and send one rewritten post with a required image to active chats on a cron schedule.

scheduled_tasks.name: cat_meme_post_broadcast
scheduled_tasks.description: Prepare and send exactly one post from post_broadcast. Call post_broadcast prepare_next with refresh=true. If it returns ok=true and has_prepared=true, write an original Russian Telegram caption under 700 characters: describe the visible cat meme image concretely, add a light intellectually funny observation, do not use generic titles such as Cat memes, do not invent facts beyond the image/source, and include the provided source_url. Then call post_broadcast send_prepared with prepared_id and the rewritten caption. If no post is prepared, report the reason briefly.

components.idle: Prepare one image post for broadcast.
